Name: Matching Slime Hutch
Author: SlushieSlowpoke
Description:
***2025 HELLO I'M NOT DEAD***

Hi everyone! First of all thank you all so much for the years of community Stardew Valley has provided for me and for all the love this mod has received over the years. I had initially made this just for myself and thought others may like it years ago, and I feel very happy knowing so many people liked it! <3

That being said, this mod is [b]VERY OLD[/b] and I would highly recommend using the updated versions others in the community took upon themselves in my absence!
If you like my mod please check out and use [b]Matching Slime Hutch - Redux[/b] https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22492 instead! It looks like it has been updated for 1.6 and it looks great!

Thank you all again for all the love and happy farming! <3




-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

I was bothered immensely by the extremely different appearance of the slime hutch so I made a new outside for it.

[b][size=3]Please note that this only changes the outside of the building! The inside and functions have not been touched what-so-ever!

[/size][/b]Thank you so much for checking this out <3
